{{Quote|Inform the commander that Lord Vader's shuttle has arrived.|[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Endicott/Legends|Endicott]]|<ref name="Episode 6">{{Film|VI}}</ref>}}
'''ST 321''' was the [[Comm unit/Legends|comm unit]] designation of a [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] belonging to [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. The transport most notably ferried the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] to the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]], which was undergoing construction above [[Endor/Legends|Endor]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:Shuttle1080i.jpg|thumb|left|200px|ST 321 in the ''Executor''{{'s}} hangar]]
ST 321 was equipped with [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] jammers, specialized tactical displays, and other modified features, such as advanced targeting systems.<ref name="Special Edition Limited">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=Vader's Personal Shuttle}}</ref><ref name="SWPM">{{PocketModel|set=Base Set|cardname=Darth Vader's ''Lambda''-class shuttle|link=http://www.swpocketmodels.com/images/shipp2.jpg}}</ref> The "ST" in the shuttle's designation stood for "space transport."<ref name="GG8">''[[Galaxy Guide 8: Scouts]]'', by [[Bill Olmesdahl]] and [[Bill Smith]], [[West End Games]], [[1993]]</ref> It was escorted by a contingent of TIE/LN starfighters, which included [[Black 11]].

[[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vader's shuttle featured a [[Darth Vader's meditation chamber/Legends|meditation chamber]] aboard similar to the one on his [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnought]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']].<ref name="Vader's Imperial Shuttle">{{TCG|set=The Empire Strikes Back|link=https://swtcg.com/Content/Images/Cards/ESB/Vaders_Imperial_Shuttle_A.webp?v=2|cardname=Vader's Imperial Shuttle (A)}}</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|Command station, this is ST 321. Code clearance blue. We're starting our approach.|Captain [[Yorr/Legends|Yorr]], approaching the second Death Star|<ref name="Episode 6" />}}
One of ST 321's earliest uses was in [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], where it was returning [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and the Supreme Commander,<ref name="kenner">{{KennerCite|set=Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (toy line)|pack=Darth Vader vs. Prince Xizor|link=soteKxizor-vader.asp}}</ref> Darth Vader from Yinchorr. It was boarded by six [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] cloned from [[Sa Cuis]]'s genetic template led by the treacherous [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Sheyvan]], alongside [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Erv Lekauf]] and [[Clone stormtrooper|cloned stormtroopers]] derived from the latter's template. During the journey, the ambitious [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] made his bid to usurp the two reigning [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]], resulting in a skirmish; the engagement ended with Vader killing Sheyvan in a quick duel. The loyal Lekauf, however, was severely burned from the fires aboard the vessel.<ref name="Two-Edged Sword">{{InsiderCite|85|A Two-Edged Sword}}</ref>

[[File:ColonelJendon-SWM.png|thumb|right|250px|Colonel Jendon was co-pilot with Captain Yorr prior to the Battle of Endor.]]
Throughout the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]] and the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Supreme Commander utilized the shuttle when he needed to make a personal appearance to motivate the Imperial forces.<ref name="TFU databank">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]'' databank entry: Imperial Shuttle</ref> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Vader&mdash;accompanied by a unit of [[Triumphant-class dark trooper|''Triumphant''-class dark troopers]]&mdash;used this shuttle during the operations [[Operation Molecular Clamp|Molecular Clamp]], [[Operation Sieve|Sieve]], [[Operation Lumberjack|Lumberjack]], [[Operation Overlord|Overlord]], [[Operation Green Light|Green Light]], [[Operation Take Down|Take Down]], [[Operation Clenched Fist|Clenched Fist]] and [[Operation Dark Glory|Dark Glory]] to travel to the cities of [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]], [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet]] and [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], respectively.<ref name="SWG:operations">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=other}}Imperial Quests: "Operation Molecular Clamp," "Operation Sieve," "Operation Lumberjack," "Operation Overlord," "Operation Green Light," "Operation Take Down," "Operation Clenched Fist," "Operation Dark Glory"</ref> In addition, he used the shuttle to travel to Theed during Empire Day Festivities to personally present several dedicated Imperial officers with awards for acts of service and loyalty to the Empire.<ref name="Star Wars Galaxies">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> A year later, [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Vader used the shuttle to travel to Bespin during [[Occupation of Bespin|its occupation]] by Imperial forces to coerce its [[Baron Administrator/Legends|administrator]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], who was also a former acquaintance of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], into delivering him, [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]], and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] to him. After losing young [[Jedi training/Legends|Jedi trainee]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] during their duel, he used the shuttle to return to his flagship, the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] ''Executor''.

Shortly before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the ST 321 ferried Lord Vader from the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial'' II-class Star Destroyer]] [[Avenger/Legends|''Avenger'']] to the second Death Star.<ref name="Episode VI novelization">[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi'' novelization]]</ref> Luke Skywalker used this shuttle to escape the [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] along with his deceased father.<ref name="The Rise and Fall of Darth Vader">''[[The Rise and Fall of Darth Vader]]''</ref> The [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] got to the late [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Lord's shuttle relatively easily, as the Imperials were in the middle of an evacuation at the time.

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Return of the Jedi (radio)|''Return of the Jedi'' radio dramatization]] states that Luke escaped the second Death Star in [[Emperor's personal shuttle/Legends|Emperor Palpatine's shuttle]]. The novel ''[[The Rise and Fall of Darth Vader]]'' counters this by stating that the escape was made in Vader's shuttle. This is supported by [[Starships of the Galaxy (Saga Edition)|''Starships of the Galaxy'']], which states that Palpatine's shuttle was destroyed with the second Death Star.

The shuttle later reappeared in the 1997 re-releases of ''The Empire Strikes Back'' when Vader returned to the ''Executor'' during the film's climax, largely due to their reusing the scene of Darth Vader's arrival on the Death Star II from ''Return of the Jedi''.<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}} {{C|[[The Star Wars Trilogy Special Edition|Special Edition]]}}</ref>
